title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00014 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:30: R/d WL riser above BOP, l/d same
00:30 - 03:30: R/d WL BOP and lower riser joint. Removed all WL equipment from rig floor and moon pool. Pulled fox hole to be able to lift WL BOP from moon pool. Lifted WL BOP from the moon pool to the pipe deck
03:30 - 03:45: Performed pre-job meeting to remove hatches. Meanwhile removed BX elevator and installed chains in bails
03:45 - 04:15: Removed split hatch on f-11. Removed hatch on adjacent well. Removed beam
04:15 - 04:30: Performed pre-job meeting to remove x-tree and AAR for WL operation
04:30 - 04:45: Installed lifting cap w/ tugger. Meanwhile performed pressure tests of kill/choke manifolds
04:45 - 05:00: Removed master bushing and outer ring. Meanwhile performed pressure tests of kill/choke manifolds
05:00 - 05:30: Lowered diverter chains on TDS bails to wellhead and attached to x-tree with double securing. Took weight as per lifting plan and removed grayloc clamp. Meanwhile performed pressure tests of kill/choke manifolds
05:30 - 06:15: Lifted x-tree to moon pool. Transfered load to gantry crane in moon pool. Meanwhile performed pressure tests of kill/choke manifolds
06:15 - 06:45: Attached lifting arrangement from TDS to spacer spool. Lifted same to rig floor. Meanwhile performed pressure tests of kill/choke manifolds
06:45 - 07:00: Installed outer ring and MB. Meanwhile landed x-tree on skid and started to make up grayloc clamp. Meanwhile performed pressure tests of kill/choke manifolds
07:00 - 07:15: Performed pre-job meeting to install hatches in moon pool
07:15 - 08:45: Continued to m/u x-tree to bracket. Installed fox hole. Installed hatches in moon pool, prepared to test TDS.
08:45 - 11:00: Installed communication collar on well head using tugger line from rig floor. Meanwhile p/u riser from cantilever
11:00 - 11:15: Lowered HP riser to well head m/u same, installed master bushing and covers in moon pool
11:15 - 12:45: Built scaffolding in moon pool for BOP/NT2 connector. Meanwhile

sections.text: R/d WL riser above BOP, l/d same
R/d WL BOP and lower riser joint. Removed all WL equipment from rig floor and moon pool. Pulled fox hole to be able to lift WL BOP from moon pool. Lifted WL BOP from the moon pool to the pipe deck
Performed pre-job meeting to remove hatches. Meanwhile removed BX elevator and installed chains in bails
Removed split hatch on f-11. Removed hatch on adjacent well. Removed beam
Performed pre-job meeting to remove x-tree and AAR for WL operation
Installed lifting cap w/ tugger. Meanwhile performed pressure tests of kill/choke manifolds
Removed master bushing and outer ring. Meanwhile performed pressure tests of kill/choke manifolds

Lowered diverter chains on TDS bails to wellhead and attached to x-tree with double securing. Took weight as per lifting plan and removed grayloc clamp. Meanwhile performed pressure tests of kill/choke manifolds
Lifted x-tree to moon pool. Transfered load to gantry crane in moon pool. Meanwhile performed pressure tests of kill/choke manifolds
Attached lifting arrangement from TDS to spacer spool. Lifted same to rig floor. Meanwhile performed pressure tests of kill/choke manifolds
Installed outer ring and MB. Meanwhile landed x-tree on skid and started to make up grayloc clamp. Meanwhile performed pressure tests of kill/choke manifolds
Performed pre-job meeting to install hatches in moon pool
Continued to m/u x-tree to bracket. Installed fox hole. Installed hatches in moon pool, prepared to test TDS.
Installed communication collar on well head using tugger line from rig floor. Meanwhile p/u riser from cantilever
Lowered HP riser to well head m/u same, installed master bushing and covers in moon pool
Built scaffolding in moon pool for BOP/NT2 connector. Meanwhile pressure tested TDS
Lifted BOP from stump and skidded same f-11
Troubleshoot BOP lifter sensor fault on test stump
Landed BOP on stump and m/u nt2 connector. Installed tension cylinder. Meanwhile drifted pipe in derrick
Removed master bushing and installed slick joint and diverter. M/u bolts on slick joint, and removed lift gear on diverter
Pressured up diverter system, meanwhile drop checked on BOP and carried out housekeeping in moon pool
Filled the well with sea water, using trip tank
Pressure tested connection on BOP and riser to 20/300 bar for 5/10min against shallow set plug
Cleaned and cleared rig floor
Lifted casing tong to rig floor. Meanwhile broke out FOSV from side entry assembly for testing offline
Performed pre-job meeting to r/u casing tong
R/u casing tong
Performed pre-job meeting to p/u THRT
P/u and m/u THRT. Reconfigured pups in the string for space out
Troubleshoot issues w/ casing tong, unable to b/o connection. Removed tong tension level and grinded same
Continued to p/u and m/u tubingthrt. POOH, installed control lines and inspected THRT
